_desc: Seattle topology (s03 reference, 134 ITM repeaters + 4 corners), extended to 60 min with 360 sends distributed across 16 active identities (12 named repeaters + 4 corners). Baseline mean inter-send 10000ms + 6 burst windows at 5/15/25/35/45/55 min (5 sends in ~3s each). Per-node startup jitter [0, 60000] ms so the warmup phase isn't synchronized — desyncs initial route-aging so the network doesn't collapse in lockstep at the global TTL boundary. Goal: surface time-windowed congestion and steady-state behavior past the s03 cold-start phase.
